[ "${HERDR_ENV:-}" != 1 ] && [ "${AGENTS_HISTORY:-1}" != 0 ] && [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/agents" ] || exit 0; d="${AGENTS_DATA_DIR:-${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/tuidev/agents}"; [ -n "$(find "$d/sample.stamp" -mmin -60 2>/dev/null)" ] || exit 0; h="$(dd bs=8192 count=1 2>/dev/null)"; s=; case "$h" in *'"session_id"'*'"'*'"'*) s=${h#*'"session_id"'}; s=${s#*'"'}; s=${s%%'"'*} ;; esac; case "$s" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) ;; *) [ ! -e "$d/waiting/$s" ] || exit 0 ;; esac; { printf '%s' "$h"; cat; } | "$HOME/.local/bin/agents" hook wait-start >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

d="${AGENTS_DATA_DIR:-${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/tuidev/agents}/waiting"; for w in "$d"/*; do [ -e "$w" ] || exit 0; h="$(dd bs=8192 count=1 2>/dev/null)"; s=; case "$h" in *'"session_id"'*'"'*'"'*) s=${h#*'"session_id"'}; s=${s#*'"'}; s=${s%%'"'*} ;; esac; case "$s" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) ;; *) [ -e "$d/$s" ] || exit 0 ;; esac; [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/agents" ] && { printf '%s' "$h"; cat; } | "$HOME/.local/bin/agents" hook wait-end; exit 0; done; exit 0
